title: Addressing the Ingestion engine
description: How to write for a reader acting as Ingestion engine. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

rules.title: Provenance-carrying
rules.description: Provenance-carrying. Every extracted fact names where it came from and how confident the extraction was.

source.quote: Turns an uploaded source into corpus. Works from documents of unknown quality and must record provenance for everything it derives, because a derived claim with no source is unusable later.
